product_metadata.title: DVC Replacement Vacuum Bags for Panasonic Upright, Bernina Evolution 6000 Series Uprights and Prestige EZT Models - Compare to Panasonic Style U, U-3, U-6 Bags | Includes 12 Standard Vacuum Bags

COMPATABLE VACUUM MODELS: These bags fit Panasonic models MC-V5100, 5200, 5300, 5500, 6200, 6300, 6600, 6700, 6800, 6900. Also They fit Bernina Evolution 6000 series uprights and Prestige EZT. They fit just like the OEM bag to ensure your vacuum is working at its full potential!
OEM STANDARDS: Compare to Panasonic Style U, U-3, U-6 bags. Our customers have come to recognize the DVC brand and trust the performance of our bags.

EXCEPTIONAL QUALITY: DVC Micro-Lined vacuum filters, bags, and other parts and accessories have been manufactured for over 26 years. DVC Products works to design and produce top-of-the line high quality and high efficiency products that perform phenomenally at an affordable price!

GREAT VALUE: Receive 12 replacement bags! Changing your vacuum bag on a regular basis ensures it is kept working to its full potential, meaning you will be spending less time cleaning and more time relaxing.
